system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: skills load in two layers, so a 5-agent session holds ~17-19K tokens of skill context on ordinary tasks
system_prompt_style.note: Inferred from layered skill loading into runtime-native layouts; no prompt-builder code in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `/deepinit` | Maps your existing codebase into AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and docs
env_context_strategy.note: Runs on top of coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) whose agents explore the repo; deepinit adds file maps.

observation_format.note: Only text/JSON artifacts described; no image observations in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: APM ships skills only. For workflows, rules, `oma-config.yaml`, keyword-detection hooks, and the `oma agent:spawn` CLI
tool_schema_source.note: Skills/workflows are hand-authored markdown; no schema generator shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: `oh-my-agent` keeps `.agents/` as the single source of truth and projects it into each runtime's native layout
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mention in the available evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: `/ralph` | Repeats `/ultrawork` until an independent verifier passes every criterion
loop_primitives.note: Also: after 2 failed retries, orchestrate spawns hypothesis variants in parallel (multi_attempt); /plan then /work (plan_execute).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: checks four artifacts a shortcut can't fake: ultrawork's phase records, the plan JSON

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: **oma-orchestration** | Runs multiple agents in parallel from the CLI.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawned as a separate agent with fresh context, briefed on the criteria only

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Just chat. Describe what you want and oh-my-agent figures out which agents to use.
human_in_loop.note: No approval gating described; gates are mechanical, not human.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: an agent that writes anything else into the state file gets it ignored, never run

long_term_memory.note: Skills library plus persisted AGENTS.md/ARCHITECTURE.md docs from /deepinit.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Every gate pass, gate failure, and decision appends one JSON line to `.agents/state/sessions/{sid}/events.jsonl`
state_persistence.note: Append-only event log plus state file; no explicit resume path shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: refuses to end your session until your project's own `typecheck` / `test` / `lint` script exits 0
self_verification.note: Independent judge agent = llm_judge; QA/review agents = self_critique.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `/ralph` | Repeats `/ultrawork` until an independent verifier passes every criterion
retry_policy.note: Reinforcement capped at 5 in the stop hook.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `session.quota_cap` caps tokens, spawn count, and per-vendor spend; the orchestrator refuses the next spawn when a dimension is exceeded
termination_condition.note: Wall-clock budget also ends the run via the Stop hook; model_declared = session stop attempt allowed once gates pass.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Set `model_preset` in `.agents/oma-config.yaml` to choose which AI models each agent uses
cost_controls.note: token_budget from session.quota_cap capping tokens and per-vendor spend.

timeouts.evidence_quote: When the wall-clock budget runs out, the Stop hook stops honestly with partial status recorded on the event log

execution_isolation.note: Installed locally and drives host CLIs; no container isolation mentioned.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: `detectWorkspace` reads pnpm / nx / turbo / lerna and routes each agent to its workspace
filesystem_access.note: Relative to host boundary; no path restriction described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: The install scripts below auto-install bun, uv, and serena if they're missing.
network_policy.note: No network restriction described anywhere in the README.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Only `typecheck`, `test`, and `lint` are executable — an agent that writes anything else into the state file gets it ignored, never run.
permission_model.note: Allowlist applies to gate scripts; underlying runtime's own permissions not described.

tracing.evidence_quote: Append-only, cross-vendor, auditable after the run.
tracing.note: events.jsonl per session; oma-observability agent covers traces for user projects, not the harness itself.

replayability.evidence_quote: deterministic replay from fixtures, manifests for reproducibility
replayability.note: Claim concerns content/research pipelines; agent runs only auditable via event log.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `oma skills eval` measures utility lift on held-out tasks — treatment vs. baseline
eval_hooks.note: Also benchmarks/README.md and `oma verify triggers` against a 171-prompt corpus.

guardrails.evidence_quote: a shared core (scope violation, charter alignment, hardcoded secrets, TODO scan, declared outputs)
guardrails.note: Stop-hook gate blocking termination and the script allowlist are action policies; secret scanning treated as output filtering.

target_domain.evidence_quote: oma ships content and research pipelines built to the same engineering discipline
target_domain.note: other = content generation (image, video, voice, slides).

open_source.note: LICENSE file present; specific licence text not in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: **Multi-vendor** — mix Antigravity, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, and Qwen per agent type
